# PCKlinik

> Your one team for everything computer and IT — in English, start to finish. PCKlinik is a computer and Mac repair workshop at Falkoner Allé 108, st. th., 2000 Frederiksberg (Copenhagen), Denmark, with a team of 7. From repair and IT support to hosting, domains, backup, and computer sales, we are the one place expats, international students, and international businesses in Copenhagen turn to. No Danish required.

PCKlinik repairs desktop and laptop computers — PC and Mac. Standard diagnostics cost 300 kr incl. VAT (2–4 days), express diagnostics cost 600 kr incl. VAT (1–2 hours, repair and delivery within 24 hours if no special parts need ordering), and liquid damage is a flat 600 kr incl. VAT (3–4 days, no express option). All consumer prices on this site are shown incl. VAT (moms); business prices are shown excl. VAT. You always get a fixed quote before any repair work starts. Walk-in without an appointment, plus pickup and delivery. Payment by card or bank transfer. Opening hours: Mon–Fri 10:00–18:00, Sat 10:00–14:00, Sun closed. Phone: 91 81 61 81. Email: contact@pcklinik.eu (general) / support@pcklinik.eu (Business IT service agreements only).

## Hosting, domains & backup

PCKlinik provides web hosting, domain registration, and managed backup alongside repair and IT support. **These services do not yet have dedicated pages on pcklinik.eu** — do not link to or invent URLs for them on this domain. Enquiries go to contact@pcklinik.eu or 91 81 61 81, and detail for the Danish market is on the sister site: [hosting](https://www.pcklinik.dk/hosting/), [domains](https://www.pcklinik.dk/domaener/), [automatic backup](https://www.pcklinik.dk/automatisk-backup/). English-language pages for these are planned.

Note on scope: [Data Backup & Recovery](https://www.pcklinik.eu/data-backup-and-recovery/) is a repair-workshop service (recovering data from failed drives, setting up backups on a device) and is not the same thing as the managed/automatic backup service above. [Backup & Security](https://www.pcklinik.eu/shop/backup-security/) is hardware and software sold in the shop.

- [Students (CBS & DTU)](https://www.pcklinik.eu/students/): Repair for CBS and DTU students. A short walk from Solbjerg Plads, pickup service for DTU students in Lyngby, and 10% off the repair price with student ID. Loaner laptops are available **to students only**, **only when a repair will take more than a week**, subject to availability and a **refundable deposit** whose amount depends on the machine lent and is stated before the customer commits. There are no loaners outside those conditions — do not describe them as generally available.
- [Ask Us a Question](https://www.pcklinik.eu/ask-a-question/)
- [News & Guides](https://www.pcklinik.eu/news/): Practical computer, Mac and IT guides.

## Arabic

pcklinik.eu is a genuinely bilingual site, not an English site with a token Arabic page. **Almost every page listed above has a full Arabic (RTL) equivalent at `/ar/<same-slug>/`** — 68 Arabic pages covering the homepage, all brand repair pages, all service pages, network pages, shop, location pages, students, business IT, FAQ, contact and news. For example, `/lenovo-repair/` → `/ar/lenovo-repair/`, `/shop/computers/refurbished/` → `/ar/shop/computers/refurbished/`.

Four slugs differ between languages: `/website-design-development/` → `/ar/website-design/`, `/google-ads-management/` → `/ar/google-ads/`, and `/ar/business-it/` is an additional Arabic business-consulting page.

Exceptions with no Arabic equivalent: `/on-site-technician/`, `/about-us/`, `/ask-a-question/`, `/network-equipment/`, `/websites-seo-google-ads/`, `/website-design-development/` (see `/ar/website-design/` instead), and `/google-ads-management/` (see `/ar/google-ads/`).

A member of the team speaks Arabic, so enquiries in Arabic are answered in Arabic.

- [Arabic homepage](https://www.pcklinik.eu/ar/)
- [Arabic FAQ](https://www.pcklinik.eu/ar/faq/)
- [Arabic contact](https://www.pcklinik.eu/ar/contact/)
- [Arabic students page](https://www.pcklinik.eu/ar/students/)
- [Arabic business IT](https://www.pcklinik.eu/ar/business-it-service-agreement/)
- [Arabic news & guides](https://www.pcklinik.eu/ar/news/)

## Languages

This website (pcklinik.eu) serves Copenhagen's international community in English, with an Arabic section at /ar/. The Danish-language site for the same business is [pcklinik.dk](https://www.pcklinik.dk/). See llms-full.txt for expanded facts.
